originalRequirement: opponents use recognizable builds with exploitable weaknesses.
status: HELD — concrete executable source prepared; no build or product execution
scope: One measured early military delay from the recognized depot-first opening under a matched ordinary paid infantry pressure policy. Existing recognizable-build evidence remains at its recorded pins. No victory, win-rate or all-opening balance requirement.

configuration.nativeDefaults: No biome/world/content/draft package and no handicaps. Normal createMatch defaults supply equal wood420/ore220/crystal0 banks, income factor1, population limit100, initial cap12, one native HQ, five workers and one native starter fighter per side.
configuration.allowedSetup: Only createMatch with the declared config before constructing MatchRecorder. No spawnDefinition, raw state assignments, teleporting, seeded extra units/resources, wounded HP, altered cooldowns, altered orders, runtime/controller edits or disabled opponents.

initialComparison: Retain both original recorder.initial SAVE4 envelopes. Their complete contents must differ only in aiConfigs[1].opening; compare without excluding runtime, controllers, banks, entities, terrain or other fields.

timing.budgetScope: The 180-second wall budget includes the one two-arm driver, two artifact-only native validator processes and termination grace. Driver receives TERM by115 seconds then KILL by120; each validator receives TERM by25 then KILL by30. An outer supervisor enforces a180-second hard process-group deadline. Future helper bundling/authentication must finish before the runtime probe begins and remains held separately.

policyInformation: Use one persistent PlayerView(0).observe(state). All command actor IDs, available bank, queues, completed units, construction destination candidates, deposits and worker targets come from that own observation. Public map.starts[1] may guide scouting. Full-state/defender diagnostics belong only to the read-only auditor and never select a target, command, release time or economy action.

publicCommandPolicy.rule: At tick0 issue hold to the ordinary initial nonworker IDs from side0 observation; do not dispatch them. They may still fire when attacked at home. Record their responses separately and exclude them from paid recruit completion and qualifying harassment sources.

At the next policy boundary, choose all five ordinary initial owned worker IDs, sorted ascending. Build one barracks through issueCommand with those IDs. Candidate centers are half-tile grid points in currently observed terrain 4.5–7 tiles from the observed owned HQ, same level; order by greatest projection toward public enemy start, then smallest squared distance to own HQ, then y, then x. Record each accepted/rejected attempt and stop candidates on first acceptance. Rejections add no fixture edits; no canPlace/full-state target query is used by policy. Retry from current observation only once per policy boundary until accepted or bounded stop.

Do not interrupt builders before the owned barracks has progress1 in PlayerView. Cooperative building is a declared adjustment from the original singular-builder outline; the one public foundation costs160wood/50ore and each worker in range contributes normal construction progress.

After barracks completion, assign workers sorted by ID to three wood slots and two ore slots. For each worker choose only resources with visible:true, matching kind and amount>0, sorted by squared distance then ID. Keep a valid current gather order; retry when idle or its current node is no longer usable. Never use stale remembered resource entries as visible targets.

Once the owned barracks completes, issue up to three accepted train role:melee commands. Observe the actual bank and owned queue before each attempt. Record the exact immediate debit70wood/25ore/0crystal per accepted command, total210wood/75ore. Continue missing accepted slots at later policy boundaries; do not cancel/refund. Track completion from actual train events and own observed new nonworker IDs; exclude initial IDs. Queueing three fits default banks and capacity; completion of all three is not required before pressure starts.

Before tick1200 keep completed paid infantry held at the observed owned barracks. At and after tick1200, dispatch each completed paid recruit individually; never wait for the whole sequential108-second train queue. Use the same deterministic policy in both arms.

For each live completed paid recruit, choose a currently observed hostile worker on the same level, nearest squared distance then lowest ID. If already attacking that same visible worker, keep the order; otherwise issue attack and retain the exact command-time own observation containing target ID/HP/position. If no worker is currently observed, issue attackMove toward public enemy start only when no prior pressure order remains. When an attack target leaves observation, choose again from a fresh own observation. No abilities, free summons or arbitrary hidden entity lookup.

auditor.readOnly: May read complete saved state and step events to authenticate outcomes, but contributes no gameplay commands or mutations. Capture events after every .05 step; the next step clears them.
recognizableCommitments: First newly paid non-HQ building role, foundation ID/tick, expected native cost, complete before/after native bank/queue/research diagnostics and every same-step income/spend component. Expansion must be depot-first and control barracks-first. Show the actual cost charged after accounting for same-step worker recruitment, research and delivered resources; do not label the whole bank delta as building cost.
First barracks foundation and completion tick.

First paid nonworker queue insertion and first paid nonworker train completion tick/ID for side1. Count neither the default starter nor a summoned/raised unit as the first paid fighter. AI public commands issued during stepping are regenerated by replay rather than emitted as independent recorder commands; preserve queue diagnostics separately.
hitEvidence: Retain all ordinary attack events, not only the first exchange.

A qualifying event has side0, positive resolved amount, a source actually completed from the paid melee queue, and the same worker targeted by an accepted public attack whose own-observation snapshot contains it.
Retain complete pre/post step victim HP or lethal death evidence and positions; distinguish damage to shield/HP and unrelated combat.

At every worker hit retain defender starter, paid fighter IDs/counts, their positions/orders and ordinary retaliation events. No AI retaliation, worker death or fixed damage threshold is an additional pass gate.
auditor.causalLimit: Retain pre-first-hit foundation, completed-barracks and first paid combat-queue milestones. If those do not precede the first damaging pressure, report that the pressure could have created part of the delay. Later first-fighter completion is explicitly an outcome under this fixed policy, not an unpressured baseline.
auditor.commandCheckpoint: Immediately after the first accepted public attack on a worker currently present in the command-time own observation, export the full native session before the next step. Name it checkpoint-at-first-worker-attack-command-session.json and retain its actual tick/action index. An earlier automatic attackMove hit may precede this checkpoint; retain that hit separately and do not describe the checkpoint as before the first hit. If no such accepted direct-target command occurs, record the checkpoint as absent.

passingComparison.recognizable: Two equal initial games produce the expected paid depot-first versus barracks-first commitment; all external actions use the same own-observation policy.
passingComparison.measuredWeakness: At least one paid-attacker ordinary worker hit in the expansion arm has controlFirstPaidFighterTick < hitTick < expansionFirstPaidFighterTick. Record exact endpoints and milliseconds/ticks; do not replace a missing endpoint with an assumed value.
passingComparison.causality: First barracks commitment/completion and first paid combat-queue differences are already retained before that arm’s first worker hit. Later worker harassment may compound the completion delay and must be described as such.
passingComparison.nativeIdentity: Original emitted sessions have SAVE4, replay checksum4 and rules4.0.1, with complete raw game envelope and complete recorder history; authenticated native verification passes full decoder/resave and replay endpoint equality without field projection.
passingComparison.noExpandedGate: A full match, victory, worker kill, specific win margin, all four advertised weaknesses, repeated seeds and browser run are outside this probe.

stopRules: For each arm start a12-second response observation window once three paid train commands, the first defender paid fighter completion and at least one ordinary paid-recruit worker hit are retained. Continue recording all hits and normal responses during that window.
Stop at tick3600 regardless of missing prerequisites, or sooner at window completion or native game-over. Game-over is an observed stop, never a victory requirement.

If any endpoint, hit, causal milestone or equality check is absent, record unmet with retained native artifacts. Do not widen duration, add units/banks, change seed/tactics, replace hidden targets, disable defenders or add automatic runs.
nativeArtifactsPerArm: checkpoint-at-first-worker-attack-command-session.json if a public direct-worker attack is accepted

existingHelpers.avoidUnrelatedPreparation: The committed controls prepare entry also runs minimap generation and a web build. They are unnecessary for this headless opening probe. existingHelpers.futureVerifierInvocation: The concrete run.sh invokes native validator.mjs with endpoint, output receipt, full pin, actual build-manifest and optional command checkpoint under one per-arm25-second TERM/30-second KILL cap.

It verifies complete parsed session, resaved raw game/runtime and replay endpoint/checksum/analysis/technology equality for endpoint and any command checkpoint in one per-arm process; it does not require continuation.
existingHelpers.continuationHandling: The committed controls verifier continuation is inapplicable to terminal or actor-depleted endpoints and is not a feature53 acceptance gate. Do not run it as an automatic retry or add a nonterminal-survival requirement. No continuation result is claimed by this prepared artifact-only validation plan.

executionAuthorization: Runtime remains held. Root must assign the serial slot to AI before any bundle build, simulation, replay or native validator is executed. No product or feature-status changes are proposed.

commandsAfterRuntimeRelease.freshDirectories: Replace NEW with unused directory names. Build and output directories must not already exist. No package installation or general app build is needed.
commandsAfterRuntimeRelease.budget: Bundling/authentication precedes the probe. run-supervisor.mjs owns detached native process groups, sends group TERM/KILL at115/120 and25/30 seconds, retains the global180-second group KILL deadline after leader exit, and inspects Linux /proc to drain runnable descendants before any next stage or metadata finalizer. Post-guard finalization reads/writes artifacts only.

outputLimits.retention: Retain full before/after audit snapshots only on bank/queue/research changes, paid-ledger insertions or actual build/train/research/combat/death events. Animation and production-progress advances alone do not emit redundant copies. The arm stops incomplete/unmet if any append would exceed its file cap, retaining native endpoint and real raw prefix. Final receipt computes actual JSONL and total retained byte sums.

auditFailureHandling: Blocked-spawn refund/drop stops that arm incomplete/unmet before a later recruit can inherit an incorrect payment token. Same-exchange paid attacker death still permits an ordinary hit, using its pre-step paid ledger. Native train events plus prior paid queue and produced-fighter counter authenticate defender completion even if death removes its ledger entry later in that step.
nativeValidationScope: Two per-arm processes verify original endpoint and optional accepted-worker-attack command checkpoint only. No continuation or survival result is claimed.
